issue.title: Kill-and-edit still refuses named prompts that fail extract_prompt_directives
issue.description:
`,x` still refuses a prompt that *does* declare `%id` when `extract_prompt_directives` cannot parse it. A scan of recent stored prompts found ~197 historical rows that raise `DirectiveError` today (removed model aliases such as `@medium_worker` / `@epic_lander`).

This is the leftover of `ea31a2b5b`: `_verify_kill_and_edit_prompt` always parses the rewrite, so a named prompt like `%model:@no_such_alias\n%id:foo\nDo work` still becomes `KillAndEditPromptError: rewrite is not a valid prompt identity`. The kill-and-edit `%id` gate now leaves unnamed unparseable prompts alone; named ones still hard-refuse.

## Bug

- **Location:** `src/sase/agent/relaunch_prompt.py::_verify_kill_and_edit_prompt`

```python
from sase.agent.relaunch_prompt import prepare_kill_and_edit_prompt
prepare_kill_and_edit_prompt("%model:@no_such_alias\n%id:foo\nDo work", "foo")
# raises KillAndEditPromptError: rewrite is not a valid prompt identity
```

ACE Agents-tab `,x` on any such historical row toasts the error and neither kills nor seeds the prompt bar. `sase agent restart` hits the same verifier through `_rewrite_prompt_identity`.

task_type_fields.impact: ACE ,x and sase agent restart hard-refuse ~197 historical named prompts whose only parse error is a removed model alias

payload.entry: RELATED: kill_and_edit_explicit_id tale — this is the leftover the plan called out as out of scope. That tale now gates unnamed prompts (including unparseable ones) out of the verifier; named prompts that still fail extract_prompt_directives keep the old hard refusal.
